title: Cross-cycle Initiative Handoff Ledger for SLO Continuity
creator: Priya Patel
description:
Problem: Initiatives that span multiple cycles routinely lose operational context at handoff points: remaining error budget, active mitigation steps, experiment cadence, and on-call owners. That causes duplicated work, regressions against SLI targets, and delayed rollback decisions when an initiative is paused or re-scoped.

Goal: Build an 'Initiative Handoff Ledger' — a lightweight, audit-friendly artifact and automation set that travels with reliability/SLO initiatives across cycles and owners. The ledger will capture the state needed to continue safe operation of SLO-bearing initiatives during cycle transitions, including: current SLI baselines, error-budget runway, last N deploys affecting SLI, active mitigations, roll-forward/rollback decisions, and next action items.

Scope: Product-facing PM templates + Linear integration (auto-create/update ledger entry on cycle transfer), Confluence template for narrative handoff, Console dashboard snapshot links, and a small automation that notifies new assignees with the most recent error-budget snapshot and a checklist. This ticket covers the PM templates, acceptance criteria, and Linear->Confluence sync. Engineering tasks (automation and dashboard snapshots) will be split into ENG tickets and linked as dependencies.

Out of scope: Full SLO enforcement engine and enforcement-by-policy (handled by other Reliability infra work). This is a coordination artifact and light automation to reduce human error at transitions.
acceptance_criteria: A Confluence handoff template exists with fields: initiative summary, SLI targets, current error-budget remaining (last 7d and 30d), active mitigations, recent deploy changelog, runbook links, rollback criteria, and next owner list.
A Linear template (issue checklist) is published and can be applied when changing initiative ownership or moving to a new cycle.
A Confluence page is auto-created or updated when an initiative owner changes in Linear (proof-of-concept automation).
New assignee receives automated notification with links to: Confluence ledger, last 3 SLI snapshots, related GitHub PRs, and current on-call rotation for the initiative.
Pilot: 3 cross-cycle initiatives complete a handoff using the ledger without missing required rollback steps in the first 30 days post-handoff.
Documentation: 'How to perform a SLO handoff' guide exists in the Reliability Runway playbook and is linked from the ledger template.
updates: 2026-02-22: Kickoff with Reliability, Eng Infra, and Ops. Alignment on ledger fields; prioritized minimal viable fields to avoid heavy maintenance (SLI snapshots, error-budget %, mitigation list, three recent deploys, runbook links). Notes recorded: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RUN/Initiative+Handoff+Ledger.

2026-02-28: PM template v1 drafted (Confluence) and reviewed by SRE: feedback to add 'estimated time-to-recover' and 'fail-open/closed impact' fields. Updated template at https://confluence.redwood.ai/draft/pm-48213-template.
2026-03-03: Decision: keep ledger light, move advanced telemetry (TTR) to an optional section. Trade-off: reduces noise on one-pagers but requires explicit opt-in for deep metrics.
2026-03-05: ENG dependency created: ENG-92144 (Linear webhook -> Confluence create/update automation). Assigned to Eng Infra. Dependency logged below.
2026-03-08: Prototype notification payload for new assignee reviewed. Privacy check passed. Draft GitHub PR for automation: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops-scripts/pull/289.

2026-03-10: Pilot candidates selected: 'Dedicated autoscaling policy v2', 'KV cache eviction policy experiment', 'Console per-route SLO dashboard rollout'. Reached out to initiative owners for pilot onboarding.
comments: Ava Nguyen (SRE): 'Critical to include the actual window we measure SLI on (e.g., 5m P99 vs daily). Otherwise the handoff loses meaning.'
Diego Ramirez (Eng Infra): 'We'll prioritize the webhook PoC; if Confluence API rate limits are an issue we fall back to a persisted markdown page in the repo.'
Sofia Martin (Design): 'Make the Confluence template scannable — use a thermometric visualization for error-budget remaining and a clear CTA for 'Immediate steps' and 'Monitoring links.''
Marcus Lee (PM, assignee): 'Planning to run the pilot during Cycle 2026-W12. Next action: schedule 30-min handoff walkthrough with each pilot owner and capture ledger entries.'
note_for_eng: Provide Eng Infra with spec for webhook events: owner_change, cycle_transfer, and manual_ledger_update. Payload should include initiative key, last_error_budget_pct_7d, last_error_budget_pct_30d, last_3_deploy_shas, runbook_links. Keep payload <= 2KB to avoid Confluence rate issues.
pilot_plan: Identify three pilot initiatives, run handoffs during Cycle 2026-W12, gather qualitative feedback from new owners at days 3, 14, 30. Metrics: time-to-first-action post-handoff, missing runbook incidents, and SLO breach regressions.
risks: Low adoption if template is too verbose; mitigation: default to required minimal fields and surface an 'expanded diagnostics' toggle.
Confluence API rate limits impacting automation; mitigation: batched updates and fallbacks to repo markdown.
Incorrect error-budget snapshot if telemetry windows mismatch; mitigation: require SLI window field and include both 7d and 30d snapshots.
